description: Search OTX threat-intel pulses by KEYWORD — campaign, malware family or actor name, e.g. "ransomware" or "APT29". Returns pulse ID, name, description preview, tags, targeted countries, malware families, attack IDs, and indicator count. This matches pulse titles and descriptions, so a bare indicator value (an IP, domain, hash or CVE id) will find nothing here — use lookup_indicator for those.
name: search_pulses
